rss_definition: Sampled /proc/<worker-pid>/status VmHWM every 2 ms while each persistent worker remained alive. Per-family peak spans all five compile/analyze repetitions in that worker process. This is sampled kernel process high-water RSS, KiB; null means unavailable, never inferred.
formula_size_definition: Each detached Z3 statistics map is preserved verbatim as key/string-value pairs. assertion_count is a formula-size proxy only, not exact AST node count. Z3 max memory fields are preserved under their native keys/values without unit conversion.
